acceptanceCriteria: An empty citation plan yields a named NOT_PRODUCED or refusal code at the cem-cite step, matching the OCM link plan.
DOGFOOD_INTENTS_FILE, DOGFOOD_VERIFY_FILE and the agent receipts are read through a bounded reader that refuses over-bound input with a named code.
A malformed agent receipt is reported with its own code distinct from agent-receipt-tree-unknown; focused tests cover all three cases.
body: Filed 2026-10-04 from the V1-0712 output-class inventory (docs/build-log/2026-10-04-v1-0712-output-class-inventory.md), source origin/main a2615609. Confirmed from source, runtime NOT_RUN. (1) validateCitationPlan (internal/dogfoodflow/change.go:518) returns ok for a zero-byte DOGFOOD_CITATIONS file, so the cem-cite step reports PRODUCED and only the later cem-status max-unknown check catches the uncited hunks; the OCM link plan refuses the same input as empty-ocm-link-plan. (2) validateIntentManifest (change.go:326) calls os.ReadFile on DOGFOOD_INTENTS_FILE before its 16*513-byte check, and flow.go readFile (flow.go:299), used for DOGFOOD_VERIFY_FILE and the agent receipts, is unbounded. (3) noteAgentReceipt (change.go:1010) ignores the json.Unmarshal error, so prose, truncated or malformed prechange-query/prechange-impact receipts are reported as NOT_OBSERVED agent-receipt-tree-unknown rather than as malformed. Related: V1-0316 (receipt base-tree check).
title: dogfood change accepts an empty citation plan as produced, reads agent inputs unbounded, and reports a malformed agent receipt as tree-unknown
